other_text: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a travelling haunted house tour (Hell House), a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened. Special Edition Director's Cut includes Deleted scenes, director commentary, behind-the-scene videos, and original cast auditions
description: Poster features dark, eerie imagery with text announcing a special edition director's cut of 'Hell House II,' hinting at supernatural horror and mystery.
